# Policy Alpha Research

Policy Alpha Research is an independent macro and equity research platform founded by Elena Zhang. It studies how policy shifts, industrial transformation, capital rotation, company fundamentals, valuation, and market confirmation interact across long-duration investment themes.

## Primary Entity

- Organization: https://policyalpharesearch.com/
- Founder and research lead: https://policyalpharesearch.com/elena-zhang.html
- 中文作者介绍: https://policyalpharesearch.com/zh-elena-zhang.html
- Research methodology: https://policyalpharesearch.com/methodology.html
- Research themes: https://policyalpharesearch.com/themes.html
- Research archive: https://policyalpharesearch.com/articles.html
- Chinese research archive: https://policyalpharesearch.com/zh-articles.html
- Disclosures: https://policyalpharesearch.com/disclosures.html

## Core Research Themes

- Policy-driven capital flows
- AI, data-center, grid, and power infrastructure
- Industrial policy, strategic capacity, and supply-chain security
- Critical minerals and strategic materials
- ESG, capital access, and regulatory compatibility
- Attention economics and Inner Infrastructure
- Company quality, valuation context, and risk governance

## Important Notice

Policy Alpha Research publishes general information and educational research. It does not provide personal financial advice, securities recommendations for a specific client, fund solicitation, return guarantees, or asset management services. Readers should verify material data and obtain qualified professional advice before making investment decisions.
